headline: Authorities seize hundreds of phones and Starlink antennas in Bogota prison
summary: Colombian authorities seized 582 cellphones, thousands of SIM cards, modems, and six Starlink antennas during a search of 19 wings at La Picota prison in Bogota.
why: Contraband telecommunications seizures highlight operational security challenges and illicit infrastructure controls inside correctional facilities.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Prison contraband enforcement impacts security oversight and institutional control measures.
